advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Extract the shared bridge fixture setup (origin/seed/clone/identity + shim skeleton) so `bridge` and `bridge_padded` do not duplicate ~55 lines that can drift.
evidence: Both open with identical `origin = tmp_path / "origin.git"` ... bare init, seed, and `for path in (work, comp): git clone` blocks
advisory.finding: The `bridge_padded` fixture duplicates roughly 55 lines of the existing `bridge` fixture verbatim (bare-origin init, seed commit, work/comp clones, identity config, shim scaffolding) rather than sharing a helper. The only real deltas are `PADDED_COMPETITOR_PUSHES=1` and the shim's stderr-padding branch. Future changes to the harness setup must now be mirrored in two places, and the two shims can silently drift.
advisory.suggested_fix: Factor the common origin/seed/clone/identity setup into a helper parametrized by competitor count and an optional shim-tail, and build both fixtures from it.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Apply the `safe.bareRepository=all` guard consistently to both bare-origin `git log` reads (or neither), so the two tests agree on the hazard.
evidence: New test: `["git", "-c", "safe.bareRepository=all", "log", "--oneline", "tickets"]` at :344 with comment at :341-343
Existing test: `["git", "log", "--oneline", "tickets"]` at :195 reading the same `cwd=bridge["origin"]` bare repo, no guard
advisory.finding: The new test guards its bare-origin `git log` read with `-c safe.bareRepository=all` (with a comment that a global `safe.bareRepository=explicit` otherwise makes `git log` exit 128), but the pre-existing `test_push_loop_converges_under_contention` reads the same bare origin at line 194-200 with a plain `git log` and no such guard. If the hazard is real, the older test is equally exposed; the two are inconsistent.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add `-c safe.bareRepository=all` to the `git log` call in `test_push_loop_converges_under_contention` too (or route both through one helper).
